HR1_E_h2h_mae_le_B.criterion: head-to-head model E share MAE <= baseline B at the first-round eve cutoff (actual pair)

HR2_E_94_interval.criterion: actual runoff share inside model E's 94% interval in at least 2 of 3 elections (eve)

HR3_FxE_brier_le_B.criterion: Brier of "who was elected", first-round F x head-to-head E <= baseline B (eve)

scope: historical elections, first-round eve cutoff, production random-walk variant
note: three elections is very weak evidence
